services.desc: Experience authentic Alaskan hospitality, breathtaking landscapes, and a warm community spirit. It all started with too many sourdough pancakes. One day, rather than letting them go to waste, someone flung a pancake-and it flew, much like a Frisbee! Since then, the Sourdough Pancake Toss has become a nightly tradition from Memorial Weekend to Mid-August. Our semi-firm sourdough pancakes fly remarkably well, and each evening after dinner, campers gather around to see who can toss a pancake into a bucket.
